FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Hello, Amina!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Bonjour, Amina !
   B. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   C. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   D. Ça va bien, merci.

2. What does 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. And you?
   D. How are you?

3. What does 'derrière' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. under
   C. in
   D. in front of

4. How do you say 'There is a sofa in the living room.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le livre est sur la table.
   B. Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   C. C'est une table.
   D. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

5. How do you say 'The TV is in the living room.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Le chat est sous la chaise.
   C. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   D. La télé est dans le salon.

6. Which day comes after dimanche? (1 mark)
   A. mardi
   B. lundi
   C. jeudi
   D. samedi

7. Which month is 'mars'? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. June
   C. March
   D. July

8. What number is 'treize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 14
   C. 13
   D. 2

9. Which month is 'octobre'? (1 mark)
   A. October
   B. February
   C. April
   D. July

10. How do you say 'They are mangoes.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je bois un jus.
   B. C'est une banane.
   C. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   D. Ce sont des mangues.

11. What does 'le poulet' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cake
   B. chicken
   C. the carrot
   D. chips

12. What does 'la carotte' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. vegetables
   B. juice
   C. cheese
   D. the carrot

13. How do you say 'There is a storm.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait chaud.
   B. Il y a du soleil.
   C. Il y a un orage.
   D. Il y a du vent.

14. Fill in: Il ______ . (It is raining.) (1 mark)
   A. est pleut
   B. y a pleut
   C. pleut
   D. fait pleut

15. How do you say 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   B. Allez tout droit.
   C. Où est la clé ?
   D. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.

16. How do you say 'It is under the chair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   B. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   C. Elle est sous la chaise.
   D. Le lit est dans la chambre.

17. What does 'Excusez-moi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Go
   B. You are welcome
   C. Excuse me
   D. Turn

18. Which accent is on the é in bébé? (1 mark)
   A. accent grave
   B. circonflexe
   C. accent aigu
   D. cédille

19. What does 'C'est ma sœur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my brother.
   B. This is my sister.
   C. This is my father.
   D. My mother is called Grace.

20. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: Where is the bed? (1 mark)
   A. near the fridge
   B. in the kitchen
   C. under the window
   D. behind the door

21. Which little word goes with 'douche' (the shower)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

22. What does 'C'est bon pour la santé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is good for your health.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. They are oranges.
   D. I like milk.

23. What does 'J'ai deux yeux.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two ears.
   B. I have a nose.
   C. He has short hair.
   D. I have two eyes.

24. Which little word goes with 'bouche' (the mouth)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. le
   D. l'

25. What does 'Il y a du soleil.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is sunny.
   B. It is cold.
   C. Today it is raining.
   D. What is the weather like?

26. What does 'La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the key?
   B. Excuse me, where is the school?
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. The door is next to the window.

27. Read: Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Le tapis est devant le canapé. Le chat est sous la table. Question: Where is the rug? (1 mark)
   A. under the table
   B. in the kitchen
   C. in front of the sofa
   D. behind the TV

28. Which little word goes with 'jardin' (the garden)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

29. How do you say 'What is your name?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   B. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   C. Je m'appelle Amina.
   D. Et toi ?

30. How do you say 'My name is Amina.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça va ?
   B. Et toi ?
   C. Je m'appelle Amina.
   D. Ça s'écrit comment ?

31. How do you say 'the mother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. la grand-mère
   C. la famille
   D. la mère

32. How do you say 'the door' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la table
   B. la porte
   C. la douche
   D. le sac

33. How do you say 'Thursday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. jeudi
   C. mercredi
   D. vendredi

34. How do we write days of the week inside a French sentence? (1 mark)
   A. with a small letter
   B. with a capital letter
   C. with an accent
   D. all in capitals

35. How do you write the number 8 in French? (1 mark)
   A. huit
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. dix-neuf
   D. douze

36. How do you say the month 'August' in French? (1 mark)
   A. septembre
   B. août
   C. avril
   D. novembre

37. How do you write the number 11 in French? (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. dix-sept
   C. onze
   D. deux

38. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'tea'? (1 mark)
   A. té
   B. thè
   C. thé
   D. the

39. How do you say 'fish' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le poisson
   B. les frites
   C. les légumes
   D. le jus

40. How do you say 'the snow' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la neige
   B. le vent
   C. l'orage
   D. une inondation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'The door is next to the window.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'C'est une banane.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est sous la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Write the French words for: the grandfather, the grandmother, the sister (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Write the seven days of the week in French in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Il fait beau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'What is the weather like?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Write a birthday card of four lines to a friend called Njeri. (4 marks) (4 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'Tournez à gauche.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'I have a brother and a sister.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Translate into English: 'Je bois un jus.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into English: 'Bonsoir, Madame !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'There is a cake and there are balloons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

54. Write a small menu of four foods in French. (4 marks) (4 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'What day is it today?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Write the French words for: pleasant, the snow, strong (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'J'ai une bouche.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Translate into French: 'It is sunny.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'How do you spell it?' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Bonjour, Amina !
   Hello, Amina! in French is Bonjour, Amina !

2. B — How do you spell it?
   Ça s'écrit comment ? means How do you spell it?.

3. A — behind
   derrière means behind.

4. D — Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   There is a sofa in the living room. in French is Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

5. D — La télé est dans le salon.
   The TV is in the living room. in French is La télé est dans le salon.

6. B — lundi
   The week begins again with Monday.

7. C — March
   mars means March.

8. C — 13
   treize means 13.

9. A — October
   octobre means October.

10. D — Ce sont des mangues.
   They are mangoes. in French is Ce sont des mangues.

11. B — chicken
   le poulet means chicken.

12. D — the carrot
   la carotte means the carrot.

13. C — Il y a un orage.
   There is a storm. in French is Il y a un orage.

14. C — pleut
   We say Il pleut, without fait.

15. D — Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   The fridge is in the kitchen. in French is Le frigo est dans la cuisine.

16. C — Elle est sous la chaise.
   It is under the chair. in French is Elle est sous la chaise.

17. C — Excuse me
   Excusez-moi means Excuse me.

18. C — accent aigu
   The acute accent goes up from left to right.

19. B — This is my sister.
   C'est ma sœur. means This is my sister.

20. C — under the window
   Mon lit est sous la fenêtre.

21. B — la
   douche is feminine, so we say la douche.

22. A — It is good for your health.
   C'est bon pour la santé. means It is good for your health.

23. D — I have two eyes.
   J'ai deux yeux. means I have two eyes.

24. B — la
   bouche is feminine, so we say la bouche.

25. A — It is sunny.
   Il y a du soleil. means It is sunny.

26. D — The door is next to the window.
   La porte est à côté de la fenêtre. means The door is next to the window.

27. C — in front of the sofa
   Le tapis est devant le canapé.

28. B — le
   jardin is masculine, so we say le jardin.

29. A — Comment tu t'appelles ?
   What is your name? in French is Comment tu t'appelles ?.

30. C — Je m'appelle Amina.
   My name is Amina. in French is Je m'appelle Amina..

31. D — la mère
   the mother in French is la mère.

32. B — la porte
   the door in French is la porte.

33. B — jeudi
   Thursday in French is jeudi.

34. A — with a small letter
   French days are written with a small letter unless they start a sentence.

35. A — huit
   8 in French is huit.

36. B — août
   August in French is août.

37. C — onze
   11 in French is onze.

38. C — thé
   The correct spelling is thé, with its accents.

39. A — le poisson
   fish in French is le poisson.

40. A — la neige
   the snow in French is la neige.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 4 marks in total.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a banana.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: The rug is under the table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: le grand-père, la grand-mère, la sœur
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all correct in order; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is nice.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Quel temps fait-il ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Chère Njeri, Bon anniversaire ! Voici un cadeau pour toi. Ton ami, Kamau
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for chère Njeri, 1 mark for the wish, 1 mark for a sentence and 1 mark for the ending.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Turn left.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: I drink a juice.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Good evening, Madam!
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 4 marks in total.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: le riz, les haricots, le poisson, une banane
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct food.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: agréable, la neige, fort
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: On Sunday, I go to church.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have a mouth.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il y a du soleil.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ça s'écrit comment ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.
